query:
/*
 * Detection basis: Sigma registry_set_bypass_uac_using_delegateexecute
 * (46dd5308-4572-4d12-aa43-8938f0184d4f); MITRE T1548.002 DET0388/AN1094 (registry
 * half). Closes the coverage gap "registry stage of the fodhelper bypass".
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 13 -> ECS registry.path / registry.value (verified on the
 * lab stack; winlog.event_data.TargetObject is not mapped). Case-insensitive
 * comparisons; no dependency on the user SID.
 * Boundary: a registry signal only - it does not prove elevation; the
 * registry->fodhelper link is TEMPORAL/CONTEXTUAL (docs/correlation-architecture.md R1).
 */
registry where
  winlog.event_id : "13"
  and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
  and registry.path : "*\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command*"
  and (
    registry.value : ("(Default)", "DelegateExecute")
    or registry.path : "*\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command\\DelegateExecute"
  )

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: Sigma proc_creation_win_uac_bypass_fodhelper (7f741dcf-fc22-4759-87b4-9ae8376676a2);
 * MITRE T1548.002 detection strategy DET0388/AN1094 (process half).

 * entity so independent executions are not merged into one alert.
 * Boundary: single process event; does not consume the registry stage or prove

process where
  winlog.event_id : "1"
  and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
  and process.parent.name : "fodhelper.exe"
  and process.name : ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe")

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: SIGMA/SAMR PowerShell command-line flag corpus; MITRE T1059.001.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1, process.command_line (raw winlog.event_data.CommandLine
 * is NOT mapped on the lab stack and was removed - EQL verification fails on
 * unmapped columns). Case-insensitive comparisons.
 * Predicate: hidden AND (bypass|unrestricted) --OR-- encoded command. The name says
 * "Encoded": an encoded command matches without requiring hidden.
 * Boundary: a command-line/context signal, not proof of script contents. Parent-name
 * exclusions were REMOVED (a parent name does not prove provenance); expect overlap
 * with S3/R2 for the WMI consumer, documented as one event seen by two signals.
 */
process where
  winlog.event_id : "1"
  and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
  and process.name : "powershell.exe"
  and (
    (process.command_line : ("*-WindowStyle*Hidden*", "*-w*hidden*", "*-WindowStyle 0*")
     and process.command_line : ("*-ExecutionPolicy*Bypass*", "*-ep*bypass*", "*-ep*unrestricted*"))
    or process.command_line : "*-EncodedCommand*"
  )

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: Sigma sysmon_wmi_event_subscription (0f06a3a5-6a09-413f-8743-e6cf35561297);
 * MITRE T1546.003 detection strategy DET0086/AN0236 (registration half).
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 19/20/21 (WmiEvent), channel Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational.
 * Name-based exclusions were REMOVED: an object name does not prove provenance.
 * Boundary: same-host ordered sequence within 30 s. It does NOT prove that the three
 * events belong to one subscription - the EID 21 Consumer/Filter references are
 * cross-checked by the acceptance verifier (EQL cannot bind values across sequence
 * events), see docs/correlation-architecture.md C2. Registration != activation !=
 * survival.
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=30s
  [any where
    winlog.event_id : "19"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation : "Created"
  ]
  [any where
    winlog.event_id : "20"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation : "Created"
  ]
  [any where
    winlog.event_id : "21"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation : "Created"
  ]

/*
 * Detection basis: MITRE T1546.003 DET0086/AN0236 (registration -> activation
 * correlation). DEPLOYMENT-AGNOSTIC: does NOT require a specific trigger binary or
 * lab script name - any WMI subscription registration followed by a WMI-hosted

    winlog.event_id : ("19", "20", "21")
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"

    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.parent.name : ("WmiPrvSE.exe", "scrcons.exe")
    and process.name : ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "mshta.exe")

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: MITRE T1546.003 DET0086/AN0236 ("anomalous child processes of
 * WmiPrvSE.exe"); Sigma sysmon_wmi_susp_scripting (name-referenced).
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1. Case-insensitive comparisons; wildcard fallbacks use the
 * case-insensitive 'like~' operator on the executable path.
 * Boundary: SYSTEM-scoped process-context signal (not every WMI execution). Does not
 * prove the child is driven by a malicious subscription - connecting it to the exact
 * subscription requires the WMI-Activity channel / verifier cross-check.
 */
process where
  winlog.event_id : "1"
  and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
  and (
    process.parent.name : ("WmiPrvSE.exe", "scrcons.exe")
    or process.parent.executable like~ "*\\WmiPrvSE.exe"
    or process.parent.executable like~ "*\\scrcons.exe"
  )
  and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  /* Listed interpreters and tools; legitimate WMI administration can overlap */
  and process.name : (
    "powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe",
    "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "bitsadmin.exe",
    "certutil.exe", "msiexec.exe"
  )

name: [C3] WMI-Hosted Interpreter Followed by Discovery Process
description: Ancestry-joined, same-host sequence: a WMI-hosted SYSTEM interpreter followed within 30 seconds by a listed SYSTEM discovery process whose PARENT entity is that interpreter (EQL per-clause by process.entity_id, host.name -> process.parent.entity_id, host.name). Cross-host false joins are impossible; the acceptance verifier re-checks the same ancestry from the ledger.

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: MITRE T1546.003 DET0086/AN0236 (activation half) + T1082/T1016
 * discovery after WMI-hosted execution.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1.
 * CORRELATION (verified on ES 9.5.3): EQL supports a PER-CLAUSE `by` key, so the
 * discovery event is joined to the interpreter by ancestry:
 *   step1 (interpreter) by process.entity_id
 *   step2 (discovery)   by process.parent.entity_id
 * Both events are additionally bound to the same host.name - a cross-host false join
 * is impossible. The acceptance verifier re-checks the same ancestry from the ledger.
 */
sequence with maxspan=30s

  /* WMI-hosted interpreter (SYSTEM context) */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.parent.name : ("WmiPrvSE.exe", "scrcons.exe")
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
    and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "mshta.exe")
  ] by process.entity_id, host.name

  /* Listed SYSTEM discovery process whose PARENT is that interpreter */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : (
      "arp.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "systeminfo.exe",
      "net.exe", "net1.exe", "whoami.exe",
      "nltest.exe", "nbtstat.exe", "hostname.exe"
    )
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  ] by process.parent.entity_id, host.name

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: T1005/T1074.001/T1560.001 staging/archive telemetry by ONE
 * process entity. The network stage was SPLIT OUT (see S4): this rule proves a
 * single process staged files then created an archive - nothing about transfer.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 11 (file create), both events joined by process.entity_id
 * (verified populated on the lab stack; E11 docs do NOT carry process.parent on
 * this stack, so no parent/WMI context is required - the chain links the staging
 * entity to the WMI-hosted interpreter via the run ledger).
 * Boundary: staging/create does not prove source-file collection; archive creation
 * does not prove contents or transfer (receipt is the transfer proof).
 */
sequence by host.name, process.entity_id with maxspan=2m

  /* Non-archive staging create */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "11"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and not file.extension : ("zip", "7z", "rar", "tmp", "log", "etl", "cab", "dll", "exe", "msi", "sys")
  ]

  /* Archive creation by the same entity */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "11"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and file.extension : "zip"
  ]

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: LAB ANALOGUE of upload-intent telemetry. SINGLE-EVENT signal: a
 * curl process launched by a script/interpreter whose command line carries upload
 * arguments. It proves upload INTENT by the invoking interpreter - NEVER that a
 * connection succeeded, that data left the host, or that a C2 channel exists.
 * T1041 (Exfiltration Over C2 Channel) is deliberately NOT mapped: the query cannot
 * evidence a channel or a completed transfer. This signal is mapped as the lab's
 * exfiltration-analogue intent; transfer success is proven by the sink receipt.
 * Network ownership: E1<->E3 by process.entity_id is a separate ledger/verifier join
 * (S6); a host/time E1-E3 join is NOT used (it would risk attributing another
 * process' connection to this curl). No archive name, IP, port or hostname required.
 */
process where
  winlog.event_id : "1"

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: T1070.004 deletion telemetry chained to archive creation.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 11 (zip create) + EID 23 (zip delete).
 * CORRELATION (verified on ES 9.5.3): EQL supports a PER-CLAUSE `by` key, so the
 * deletion is joined to the creation of the SAME archive path on the SAME host:
 *   step1 (create) by file.path, host.name; step2 (delete) by file.path, host.name.
 * A same-path cross-host false join is therefore impossible.
 * No archive name is hard-coded and deletion does not imply transfer success; the
 * acceptance verifier re-checks the path equality from the ledger.
 */
sequence with maxspan=2m

  /* archive creation */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "11"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and file.extension : "zip"
  ] by file.path, host.name

  /* archive deletion of that same path */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "23"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and file.extension : "zip"
  ] by file.path, host.name
